decisions.reason: Management has invested resources and publicly committed to this perfect binder since 2018, so escalation of commitment leads to persistence despite unclear market evidence.
The fully automatic perfect binder represents a higher investment and visible commitment, making management even less likely to drop it under escalation of commitment.
Although the booklet maker for inline and nearline may be less central, the firm's prior investment and public commitment still outweigh disappointing signals, so it is kept.
